Managing a Pharmacy Shouldn't Be Complicated.

Many pharmacies still rely on spreadsheets, paper ledgers and memory to run daily operations. This leads to stock-outs, revenue leakage, poor customer credit tracking and lost time.

  • Difficult stock tracking and expiry monitoring
  • Unclear daily sales and revenue
  • Difficulty monitoring expenses
  • Manual customer credit records
  • Difficulty generating business reports
  • Limited visibility into performance
  • Staff accountability challenges

Dawa Smart solves these problems

One system. Full visibility. Complete control.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Dawa Smart?
Dawa Smart is a browser-based pharmacy management system that helps pharmacies manage sales, inventory, expenses, patient records, laboratory tests and business reports.
Who can use Dawa Smart?
Dawa Smart is designed for pharmacy owners, pharmacy managers, chemists and pharmacy staff in Kenya.
What can I manage with Dawa Smart?
You can manage POS sales, product inventory, batch tracking, patient records, credit ledgers, lab tests, expenses, staff users and business reports.
Can I manage pharmacy stock?
Yes. Dawa Smart tracks real-time stock levels, batch numbers, selling prices, buying costs and expiry dates. You receive alerts for low stock and near-expiry items.
Can I track sales and expenses?
Yes. Every sale is recorded with receipt number, payment method and cashier. Expenses are categorised by type, date and amount for accurate reporting.
Can I manage staff?
Yes. You can create user accounts with role-based access control — developers, admins and cashiers each see only what they need.
Can I generate reports?
Yes. Dawa Smart generates daily, weekly, monthly and yearly reports covering revenue, expenses, profit, top-selling products, payment methods and professional analysis.
How do I get started?
Click "Open App" or "Explore Dawa Smart", then log in with the DEMO credentials. A 14-day free trial starts when you make your first sale. No installation required — it runs in your browser.
Does Dawa Smart require internet?
Dawa Smart works offline. Data is stored in your browser using IndexedDB. An internet connection is only needed for the initial page load or exporting data.
Is my data secure?
All data stays in your browser. Dawa Smart does not send data to external servers, and license/trial information is stored separately and excluded from backups.
What is the 14-day demo?
The 14-day demo gives you full access to try every feature. The trial starts on your first sale, not on login. If it expires, you can reset it to start fresh.
Does Dawa Smart support M-Pesa?
Yes. Dawa Smart supports M-Pesa, Airtel Money, card and cash payment methods, plus credit sales with customer ledger tracking.
